name: shots/twin
description: Twin Laser beam segment v2 (w15-WEAPONLOOK2): hand-drawn native comb beam — a continuous green core row with ridge spines every third column (white under green above and below), 3-px tiling period so it seams across segments; tiles horizontally (anchor at its left end). A ridged beam, not a solid bar — separates it from the FLUX twin/tail pair (w15-WEAPONLOOK § 6).
